overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the chair did not reasonably anticipate two unlisted topics, and any defect in the second was cured by rescission. The AG encouraged postponing unanticipated topics.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged a selectman moved to have town counsel record street acceptances under Other Business, a topic not listed on the December 19, 2011 notice.
allegations.key_passage: We credit that Board's assertion that the Chair did not reasonably anticipate the topic and the subsequent vote.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the chair raised a vote to remove a member from a town committee during Selectmen Reports, a topic not on the notice and given no advance notice to the affected member.
allegations.key_passage: We credit the Chair's assertion, but note that even if the Chair did anticipate discussion of this topic at least 48 hours' before its December 19, 2011 meeting, any violation of the Open Meeting Law was remedied
